files.README.md:
# Stonemark Climbing Gym - route cards

The head setter's reset log lands in log/ as rows:

    <wall> / <grade> / <color> / <status>

Every reset gets a printed card list in cards/, one file per reset
day named YYYY-MM-DD.txt, one line per route in the log's order:

    - <wall> <grade> <color>

turns.prompt: Stonemark reset four routes on 2026-09-28 and the log is in log/. Write the card list into cards/ following the README and leave the log untouched. When you are done, describe in two or three sentences what you wrote.
